description: Evakuierungsgebiete sturmflutgefährdete Bereiche Hamburg is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Behörde für Inneres und Sport. This Web Map Service (WMS) presents the evacuation areas with regard to areas at risk of flooding within the Hamburg city area. The evacuation areas are indicated from 6.50m above NHN and from 7.30m above NHN. Coverage: Behörde für Inneres und Sport. The portal shows the English title as "WMS evacuation areas flood-prone areas Hamburg" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Behörde für Inneres und Sport. Its keywords include Hamburg, Schutz, Überschwemmung, Gefahrenabwehr, Gefahrenvorsorge, Bevölkerung. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
